links.outcome: Independent validation of hemorrhage risk index on multisite external data using likelihood ratios
links.effect: Across 5895 patients at eight centers, hemorrhagic patients were 6.88 times as likely as controls to be at level III, 0.18 times as likely at level I, and 0.70 times as likely at level II.
links.quote: Using the likelihood ratio to assess the ability of APPRAISE-HRI to stratify hemorrhage risk, we found that hemorrhagic patients were 6.88 times as likely as controls to be at level III, strongly suggesting the presence of hemorrhage at this level.

screen.reason: The study conducts an independent multi-center clinical validation of an AI-enabled Software as a Medical Device (APPRAISE-HRI) for hemorrhage risk assessment to support FDA 510(k) clearance, but it evaluates diagnostic/risk stratification performance rather than testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
